race.comment: GOLD COAST BELLE (7) was backed off the map in the G2 Let's Elope Stakes to start as the $2.10 favourite, half-slow away but finding the front easily enough. Perhaps she went a bit too slow in front and faded late - third up now and Zahra on, she can atone. TENNESSEE BOUND (14) has been up for a long time but keeps racing well. GOLD COAST BELLE was too nippy for her two back before she was ridden to her strengths last time against the boys. She can roll along and wet ground will help. WROTE TO ARATAKI (6) stuck on fairly fresh at Caulfield over 1200m and is suited up in trip. GOLD MEDALLIST (15) is ready to peak and draws for a soft run.
